title: Small fixes
fixes: Phones: Raid, the PC picker, Blackjack, the You and Friends pages and the Community bar now fit on the screen.
Community feed: cheer counts show correctly again.

title: Community hub and guild chat
notes: New Community tab: Trainer, Friends and Guild are now one gold Community tab, next to the gear.
Live feed: everyone’s rare finds as they happen. Switch between Live, Top (the rarest finds of the last 24 hours, 7 days or 30 days) and Mine, for Everyone or just Friends. Every find shows its odds.
Cheer and react to your friends’ finds right in the feed, or cheer them all at once with Cheer all.
Raid, Night Market, Wonder Trade and PvP now open from Community. Research moved into Events.
Guild chat: a new Chat tab in your guild. You can report a message and delete your own, leaders and officers can mute, and a word filter keeps it friendly.
fixes: The world number next to “1 of N in the world” is gone: it could show the wrong number on Perfect Pokémon.

title: Small fixes
fixes: Card Bloom: bloomed cards no longer show as ??? after a restart.
Wonder Trade: the “left today” count now shows 0 when you have no Wonder Trades left.
